notes: The list covers most of Stravinsky's original violin works and Dushkin collaborations. Missing are the 1925 Kochański Pergolesi suite, the Kochański Firebird excerpt and two Dushkin-era transcriptions (Pastorale; Rossignol airs). Histoire du soldat (violin, clarinet and piano trio) is excluded as chamber music.
